people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.
translations.bsb: So they set up for themselves Micah’s graven image, and it was there the whole time the house of God was in Shiloh.
translations.kjv: And they set them up Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
translations.asv: So they set them up Micah's graven image which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
